reviews.body: Amazing experience! He really takes the time to guide you on what would suit your haircut and beard style best. The atmosphere is great, and I have to mention the playlist: it made the whole experience even better. He's incredibly friendly, professional, and easy to talk to. If I could give more than 5 stars, I absolutely would: definitely a 6-star experience!
